reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Zambia- TB/HIV - Zambia (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Zambia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Zambia (MOH)This program has the following goals: Avert between 170,000 and 360,000 new HIV infections by 2030. Avert between 60,000 and 123,000 AIDS related deaths by 2030. Reduce the Prevalence of TB by 50% relative to the estimated 1990 levels by 2016 and sustain the reduction in mortality. The objectives of this program are: Increase case notification rate of all forms of tuberculosis from 321/100,000 in 2012 to 338/100,000 and screen 60% of previously treated TB cases for MDR by 2016. Increase the percentage of PLHIV alive 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy from 81% in 2013 to 95% by 2016. Increase treatment success of drug-susceptible TB from 88% in 2012 to 90% by 2016. Reduce the percentage of infants born HIV positive to less than 5% by 2016. Reduce the rate of annual new HIV infections from 53,000 in 2012 to 38,662 in 2016. Successfully treat at least 70% of all MDR-TB patients initiated on treatment by 2016
